name: Righteous
overview: Scripture reveals that righteousness is closely connected to God's covenant relationship with His people, marked by obedience and separation unto Him. The Lord promises protection and great reward to those who trust in Him, as seen in His assurance to Abram and the blessings promised to his descendants as numerous as the stars. God's people are called to be a peculiar treasure, set apart from the world, inheriting His blessings through faithful obedience, which distinguishes them as His own in a special and enduring way.
